newsitem.title: CANADA: Newcourt Credit holders back stock split.
newsitem.headline: Newcourt Credit holders back stock split.

text.p: Newcourt Credit Group Inc said on Tuesday its shareholders have approved a 2-for-1 split of the company's stock.

"With the approval of the resolution...we will be able to enhance the liquidity of the stock and hopefully bring more shareholders into this group by the time we meet again next year," Newcourt president Steven Hudson said in a speech to shareholders at the company's annual meeting.
Shares in Newcourt Credit were up 0.80 at 52.80 in late afternoon volume of 181,000 shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
